capabilities: mark habit days in an interactive weekly grid and navigate between weeks
set weekly targets from 1 to 7 days with streaks that allow rest days
review per-habit yearly calendars, current streak, and best streak
store habit data as Markdown notes in a configurable vault folder
rename, recolor, archive, reactivate, and schedule target changes for habits
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later and supports desktop and mobile; documents a guarded write mechanism and explicit limits on conflict detection with external sync clients.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track weekly habit targets, streaks, and activity history without leaving the app or using an external service.
summary: Habit tracker with a weekly dashboard that stores each habit's data in a user-editable Markdown note inside the vault.
